scope: Current repository source plus explicitly unproved historical workflow metadata; this is not a complete live fence. Remote state, old refs/jobs, org/repository Secrets, host cron/manual and external writes require independent live proof.

entrypoints.name: Production Deploy
entrypoints.reason: Uploads/replaces services and configuration; database initialization may run migrations according to each service's actual config.
entrypoints.fence_action: Disable, drain/cancel old jobs, block old reruns before credentials, restore original state after verified completion.

entrypoints.name: Database Operations
entrypoints.reason: Restore, governance, cleanup and backup/retention write DB/private assets. Only two exact metadata profiles and inventory have reviewed read-only DB behavior; status is still serialized.
entrypoints.fence_action: Disable original workflow and deny all old-ref/rerun entrypoints; exact approved read-only diagnostics may be separately allowed.

entrypoints.name: Provision Production AuthZ Matrix Subjects
entrypoints.reason: Executes provisioner in current production apiserver; creates isolated IAM subjects/role assignments. Current source shares production-deploy; historical versions retained a separate group and still require credential fencing.
entrypoints.fence_action: Disable/drain and prove rerun denied before production credentials, even though its business rows are not four retirement targets.

entrypoints.name: Production AuthZ v3 Matrix
entrypoints.reason: SQL reads use a read-only transaction and no migrator; IAM access checks and privileged SSH are separate capabilities.
entrypoints.fence_action: Drain and deny obsolete source reruns; either explicitly allow exact approved diagnostic SHA or disable during the window.

entrypoints.name: Compatibility Observation
entrypoints.reason: Reads Prometheus metrics, without DB write; privileged SSH can execute source from old refs.
entrypoints.fence_action: Drain and deny obsolete source reruns; do not equate a separate read-only group with credential denial.

entrypoints.name: Attention Reconcile Dry-run Audit
entrypoints.reason: Reads existing Worker metrics/config; does not run reconcile. ServerD SSH uses fallback production keys.
entrypoints.fence_action: Drain and prove obsolete source cannot obtain ServerD/ServerA fallback credentials.

entrypoints.name: M6 QS-03 AnswerSheet Gap Read-only Audit
entrypoints.reason: Reads actual production AnswerSheet/SQL evidence via bounded standalone audit binary; uploads executable to ServerA and starts a read-only container.
entrypoints.fence_action: Drain and deny obsolete source/binary reruns before SSH/database configuration extraction.

entrypoints.name: M5 AuthZ Outage Read-only Preflight
entrypoints.reason: Reads current production container configuration. Job has no production environment, so its repo-level SSH credential path is not controlled by production ref policy alone.
entrypoints.fence_action: Include repository-credential/old-rerun boundary; production environment policy alone is insufficient.

entrypoints.name: M5 AuthZ Ephemeral Read-only Postcheck
entrypoints.reason: Reads ServerA container configuration and ServerD NSQ stats using SSH without production environment.
entrypoints.fence_action: Include ServerA/ServerD repository credential paths, drain and deny obsolete reruns before credentials.

entrypoints.name: Ping Runner
entrypoints.reason: Default calls health/config verification; shared Nginx script also has install/reload modes but this workflow invokes default verify-only. ServerA/ServerB/ServerD SSH paths are outside production environment.
entrypoints.fence_action: Include repository credentials and all hosts; do not infer rerun denial from production ref rules.

entrypoints.name: QS M6 image handoff isolation
entrypoints.reason: Published images run against disposable runner databases/NSQ; production job obtains registry credentials and exports fallback archive, not production DB/SSH in current source.
entrypoints.fence_action: Treat registry credentials separately; deny old source reruns that could alter credential handling, and avoid concurrent runner resource pressure.

entrypoints.name: Exact Compatibility Retirement
entrypoints.reason: Only the exact approved main SHA, operation and independently bound request use the existing production credential paths. Inventory/report diagnostics read originals; prepare-facts hashes seven source files in place and observes ordered Mongo schema, fixed-socket image identities and filesystem capacities without granting capture, CAS, DROP or deployment authority; prewindow historical evidence uses separately qualified locked CAS; lifecycle preparation captures exact four-target temporary assets and performs actual isolated network-none restores through the fixed root-once caller. Preparation grants no DROP/fence/window authority. A apply/verify/recover/purge remain unavailable before input/database access. All phases share production-deploy.
entrypoints.fence_action: Allow only approved main SHA/op/request or frozen manifest; no unsupported phase may return success.

entrypoints.name: Compatibility Host Read-only Inventory
entrypoints.reason: Exact approved current main and actual-run readonly transport use the existing pinned ServerA/Collection and ServerD credential routes. V1 requires independently hashed preplaced Match contexts; explicitly approved v2 observes only the final SSH session UID/NSS/connection, with Host queries skipped when UseDNS or daemon/config binding is unknown. The current Mac Runner is unsupported. Local tests and source do not prove a production management channel, full Match coverage, installation or writer isolation.
entrypoints.fence_action: Read-only observation grants no fence or execution authority. Include the existing credential paths in the later live verifier; deny obsolete refs/reruns and independently prove all writers, sessions and actual management/install prerequisites.

external_entrypoints_not_proven: ServerA/ServerD shell/manual commands and cron/systemd timers
External IAM/qs-ai/other repository deployments or maintenance
Business traffic, Worker scheduled jobs and any legacy writer in the actually deployed image
Historical workflow versions and rerun-failed-job paths
Organization/repository reusable workflows and direct repository Secrets access
